name: GitHub
summary: Your organization's issues, reviews and dependency alerts, on a dashboard and in your automations.
description:
Bring a GitHub organization into your community.

An admin connects the organization once, on GitHub's own install page, and picks the repositories the plug-in may see. Dashboards then show open issues, pull requests waiting on review, Dependabot alerts and a fortnight of throughput for everyone, with nobody pasting a token.

Automations can open, comment on, close, label and move issues, as the organization or as a member who connects their own GitHub account. Members who connect get their own review queue, and their own review requests and pull requests show in any community with the plug-in, whether or not it has connected an organization.

Tasks link to the branches and pull requests that name them, such as acme-42, and show whether each is open, reviewed and passing its checks. A task can start its own branch in GitHub, and a dashboard can list the open pull requests that name a task.

images.alt: The GitHub overview dashboard: open issues, pull requests waiting on review, Dependabot alerts by severity, and issues opened and closed by day.
A member's own GitHub widgets on a dashboard: the pull requests that asked for their review, their own open pull requests, and the pull requests that name a task.
A task with its GitHub section: two linked pull requests, one open and one merged, each approved and passing its checks, and the task's branch.

versions.release_notes: An operator's GitHub App values are checked with GitHub when saved, and an organization's owner can connect it again: the GitHub App now asks for Members read, which each organization owner accepts in GitHub. Built on initiative-plugin-sdk 11.1. Needs an Initiative serving plug-in API 11.0 (Initiative 0.80.0); an older one refuses to install it.
